content.bridge_context: Understanding 'hot' and 'cold' through the scientific lens of temperature and learning how to measure it accurately.

units.title: What is Temperature?
units.explanation: Temperature is a measure of how hot or cold an object is.
units.dual_language_instruction: Touch a cup of warm milk and a bowl of ice. Which is 'hotter'? / गर्म दूध और बर्फ को छुएं। कौन सा ज्यादा गर्म है?

units.title: The Thermometer
units.explanation: A device used to measure temperature accurately, usually in degrees Celsius.
units.dual_language_instruction: Look at a clinical thermometer. What is the normal body temperature? / क्लिनिकल थर्मामीटर देखें। शरीर का सामान्य तापमान क्या है?
